description: This file defines a class PrivilegeConstants that contains a comprehensive list of privilege names with associated descriptions, especially those marked with the AddOnStartup annotation, representing privileges related to various modules and functionalities within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: PrivilegeConstants
classes.description: A class containing static string constants representing privilege names with descriptions and annotations indicating privileges that are marked with AddOnStartup.

methods.name: PrivilegeConstants
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the class, as it serves as a constants holder.
